_doc: Damage by distance flown for a weapon's shots (ShotFalloff.mult, read in Match._shot_apply). A weapon names a class in its primary: "falloff" (full damage to start, a straight line down to floor x damage at end, the floor beyond) and optionally "ramp" (from x damage up to start, a straight line to full at end). Reference metres as they are: a weapon whose range ends before a class start never falls off.
